notes_for_editor: Thin: the only source naming this tower is one line in a 2016 list of Georgia lookout towers. Two WebSearch calls and page reads found nothing on construction, staffing, fate or the site today. The brief's register BLL US 41133 matches the list's BLL-41133; the list does not explain the code, so it is reported only as printed. The Wikipedia page for Brooks, Georgia describes a community in Fayette County, not this one, and was not used. Searches returned a Brooks County history book (c. 1961) at Valdosta State, unread. Brief status and access stay unknown.
